verifs: Date written on the day page
“My client” column of the rules table filled in before cutting (teacher checks)
Teacher check: Done + grade /20 and signature
verifsFinSemaine: All day pages of the week signed
Finished garments photographed for the portfolio

jours.obj: Meet again, review your Year 1 work and correct your mistakes before starting Year 2.
items: Welcome back: greet your classmates; check your book, tape, square ruler, hip curve, chalk and scissors.
Lay your Year 1 garments on the table; tell the class who you made them for.
Grade each garment with the 5 checks: fit, finish inside, stitching, pressing, time.
Find your 3 main mistakes; write each one and how to correct it in the table.
Correct one mistake on the garment today; the teacher checks and signs.
jours.apporter: Your best Year 1 garments (sewn for friends or family), your Year 1 notes and tools
jours.devoir: Write your 3 mistakes and how you will avoid them in Year 2.

jours.obj: Draft a fitted bodice block (front and back) that will be the base of every dress and top this trimester.
items: Draw two rectangles: back = bust ÷ 4 + 1 wide, front = bust ÷ 4 + 2 wide, both as long as the back length + 4 cm.
Neck, shoulder point X and slope 4.5 cm; join A to B on back and front.
Armhole depth bust ÷ 4 - 2; widths at half depth; draw the curves with the hip curve.
Place the bust point (down 26, in span ÷ 2); draw the side dart and the waist dart, both stopping 2.5 cm before it.
Shape the waist; true the seams: side seams and shoulders must be the same length front and back.
Add 1.5 cm on side seams, 1 cm elsewhere; cut the toile in calico.
jours.apporter: Bust, waist, shoulder, neck, back and front length, bust point, span
jours.devoir: Cut the calico toile and bring it tomorrow.

jours.obj: Fit the toile on a partner, correct the pattern and trace the final block on card.
items: Baste the darts, shoulders and side seams (4 mm stitch); press.
Fit on your partner over light clothes; pin CF and CB on the body.
Check every point of the table; pin and chalk each correction.
Unpick; report the corrections on the paper pattern (never only on the toile).
Trace the final block on card: name, measurements, grain, notches, 'BODICE BLOCK – Year 2'.
jours.apporter: Calico toile from Day 2, your partner
jours.devoir: Write every correction you made and why.

jours.obj: Turn the bodice block into a lined-look sleeveless top with an all-in-one facing, in one session.
items: Trace the block; lengthen to back length + 20 cm; hip = hip ÷ 4 + 1.
Narrow the shoulder 2 cm; raise the armhole 1 cm; widen the neck 1.5 cm and lower the front 2 cm.
Draft an all-in-one facing 5 cm wide (neck + armholes) on front and back.
Cut; sew darts and shoulders of shell and facing separately.
Attach the facing by the roll method; understitch; side seams of shell and facing in one run.
Invisible zip 40 cm at CB; hem 2 cm; press.

jours.obj: Draft every piece of the men's shirt – back, yoke, front, sleeve, collar, stand, cuff – and cut it.
items: Back: rectangle chest ÷ 4 + 3 by shirt length; neck A, shoulder X and B, armhole C, width W; yoke 8 cm under the neck.
Front: same frame; neck depth neck ÷ 6 + 1.5; front width shoulder ÷ 2 - 2.5; stand 2 + facing 3.5.
Curve the hem: side 6 cm higher than CB and CF.
Measure the armhole on the paper (back + front); draft the sleeve: cap = armhole ÷ 4, diagonals = each armhole.
Collar: stand and leaf = neck ÷ 2 + 1.5; check against the neckline measured on the paper.
Cut on grain; notches; fuse collar, stand, cuffs and facing.
jours.apporter: Neck, shoulder, chest, shirt length, sleeve, arm round, wrist
jours.devoir: Pack your pieces in order in a bag.

jours.obj: Sew the complete shirt to selling quality in one session.
items: Box pleat; back between the two yokes (roll method); shoulders to the yoke; edge-stitch 1 mm.
Fold and stitch the front facings.
Collar: sew the leaf, trim to 0.5, turn, topstitch 6 mm; sandwich in the stand; attach; edge-stitch.
Tower placket 14 cm on each sleeve; set the sleeves flat; side + sleeve seam in one line.
Pleat the sleeve to 24 cm; attach the cuffs; hem 1 + 1 cm.
7 buttonholes on the front, 1 on the stand, 1 per cuff; buttons; press.

jours.obj: Adapt the shirt pattern to a short-sleeve shirt with a precise chest pocket, in one session.
items: Trace the shirt pattern; shorten the body 4 cm (worn outside the trousers).
Sleeve: 24 cm long from the shoulder point; hem width = arm round + 6; 3 cm hem allowance.
Pocket: chest ÷ 8 wide, 14 cm high + 3 cm fold + 1 cm seams; place it 21 cm under the neck point, 6 cm from CF.
Cut; press the pocket on a card template; topstitch it 2 mm with triangle bar-tacks at the top.
Assemble as Day 6, without cuffs; hem the sleeves 3 cm, topstitched 2.5 cm.
Buttonholes, buttons, press.
jours.apporter: Shirt pattern from Day 5, arm round
jours.devoir: Draw the pocket with all its measurements.

jours.obj: Make a long men's kaftan from the shirt pattern: mandarin collar, half placket, side slits.
items: Trace the shirt front and back without yoke; lengthen to the kaftan length.
At the hip line go out to hip ÷ 4 + 4; at the hem hip ÷ 4 + 6.
Half placket 30 × 3 cm at CF, 4 buttons; mandarin collar neck ÷ 2 + 1, 3.5 cm high, on the fold.
Long sleeve, no cuff: hem = wrist + 12, 3 cm hem.
Side slits 30 cm, faced; hem 3 cm with mitred corners at the slits.
Optional: embroidery band 3 cm around the neckline and placket.

jours.obj: Draft men's trousers and mark every pocket, the fly and the waistband to the millimetre.
items: Front: crotch line = crotch depth + 1; hip at 2/3; hip ÷ 4 - 1 + 1; extension hip ÷ 16; crease in the middle.
Knee and hem centred on the crease; waist ÷ 4 - 1 + pleat 3.
Back: hip ÷ 4 + 1 + 1; extension hip ÷ 10; CB raised 3; waist ÷ 4 + 1 + dart 2.5.
Mark the slant pocket: 4 cm in at the waist, 17 cm down the side seam.
Mark the back welt: 13.5 cm long, 7 cm under the waist, parallel to it, centred on the dart.
Draft fly facing 4 × 20, shield 8 × 20, waistband waist + 4 by 8, 7 belt loops 5 × 1, pocket bags 18 × 30.
jours.apporter: Waist, hip, thigh, knee, bottom, trouser length, crotch depth
jours.devoir: Cut all the pieces and label them.

jours.obj: Sew the trousers with a double-welt back pocket, slant side pockets and a clean fly.
items: Overlock all edges except the waist; sew the back darts.
Back welt: interface, mark the box 13.5 × 1, sew two welts 0.5 cm, cut with a Y of 1 cm, turn, close the triangles, bag.
Slant pockets: stay-tape the opening, facing to the bag, French-seam the bag, baste at waist and side.
Fly zip with facing and shield; topstitch the J-curve 4 cm.
Side seams, inseams, crotch in one line; waistband with 7 loops; hook or button.
Hem 4 cm, blind stitch; press a sharp crease front and back.
jours.devoir: Portfolio photo + write the 6 steps of a welt pocket.

jours.t: Trousers with side band & side-seam pockets
jours.obj: Make ceremony or sport trousers with a contrast band set into the side seam, in one session.
items: Trace the trousers; take 1.5 cm off the front side seam and 1.5 cm off the back side seam.
Band: finished width 3 cm, cut 5 cm (two 1 cm seams), length = side seam + 4 cm.
Straight pocket in the band seam: opening 16 cm, starting 3 cm under the waistband.
Sew band to front, then to back, pocket bags in the seam; press the seams onto the band.
Fly, inseams, crotch, waistband (or elastic 4 cm).
Hem 4 cm; press.

jours.obj: Cut and sew bermuda shorts with pleated cargo pockets and flaps, in one session.
items: Trace the trousers to waist-to-knee - 4 cm; hem front thigh ÷ 2, back thigh ÷ 2 + 3.
Cargo pocket 18 × 20 with a 4 cm box pleat; flap 18 × 7; top of the flap 5 cm under the crotch line, centred on the side seam.
Slant side pockets and one back welt as Day 10.
Sew pockets first, then fly, seams, waistband.
Hem 3 cm, topstitched; press.
jours.apporter: Classic trousers pattern, waist to knee, thigh

jours.obj: Draft, cut and sew a lined pencil skirt with a CB vent and invisible zip in one day.
items: Front on the fold: hip ÷ 4 + 1; waist ÷ 4 + 0.5 + dart 2.5; side raised 1.2; hem 1.5 in.
Back: hip ÷ 4 + 1; waist ÷ 4 - 0.5 + dart 3; vent 20 × 4 at CB.
Cut shell and lining (lining 1 cm shorter, vent cut away on the right lining).
Invisible zip at CB, darts, side seams, vent.
Lining at the waist with a 4 cm waistband; hem 3 cm by hand.
jours.apporter: Waist, hip, skirt length, waist-to-hip 20 cm

jours.obj: Transform the straight skirt into a flared skirt with a hip yoke.
items: Trace the straight skirt; draw the yoke 12 cm under the waist.
Close the dart into the yoke; slash the lower part 3 times, open 3–4 cm each.
Add 10 cm of flare at the side hem; smooth the hem curve.
Cut; let it hang 1 hour before levelling the hem.
Yoke, side seams, zip; narrow rolled hem.
jours.devoir: Sketch 3 skirts you can make from this block.

jours.obj: Make a 6-panel skirt with 6 inserted godets.
items: One panel: waist ÷ 6 + 0.5; hip ÷ 6 + 0.5; straight to the hem.
Godet slit 25 cm from the hem on every seam.
Cut 6 panels and 6 godets (triangle 25 high, 20 base).
Sew the panels; set each godet point first; press.
Waistband, zip, hem.
jours.devoir: Two sentences: flare or godet, what is the difference?

jours.obj: Calculate, mark and press a skirt with 6 box pleats stitched down to the hip.
items: Fabric width = hip + 4 + 6 pleats × 12 cm.
Mark each pleat: 6 cm fold on each side of the pleat line; check the waist = waist + 2.
Stitch the pleats down 20 cm (to the hip line); press on a card.
Waistband waist + 3 × 8; zip at the left side.
Hem 4 cm before pressing the pleats to the hem.

jours.obj: Move the darts into princess seams and extend the block to a dress.
items: Draw the princess line from mid-armhole through the bust point to the waist dart.
Cut the block apart; close the darts; smooth the curves.
Extend to the dress length; hip ÷ 4 + 1 at the hip line (20 cm under the waist).
Two notches on every princess curve.
Cut shell, facings and lining.
jours.devoir: Label all pieces: name, number, grain, notches.

jours.obj: Assemble the princess dress with invisible zip and set-in sleeves.
items: Princess seams; clip curves; press over the tailor's ham.
Invisible zip at CB; close CB below.
Shoulders; neckline facing; understitch.
Sleeves with 2 rows of ease stitches; set; side seams.
Hem 3 cm; fit on a person; press.

jours.obj: Cut and sew an A-line dress with set-in sleeves in one session.
items: From the block: close the waist dart and open it as flare at the hem (+6 cm per side).
Sleeve: cap = armhole ÷ 3, width at least arm round + 5, wrist + 8 at the hem.
Cut in one layout.
Darts, shoulders, neckline facing, sleeves, sides, zip.
Hem 3 cm; press; record your time.
jours.apporter: Bodice block, dress length, sleeve, arm round, wrist

jours.obj: Make a sleeveless shift dress with hidden pockets in the side seams.
items: Remove the waist dart; keep the bust dart; waist shaped only 1.5 cm in at the side.
Hip = hip ÷ 4 + 1.5; straight to the hem.
Pocket: opening 16 cm starting 8 cm under the waist; bag 20 × 25.
Sew the pocket bags to the side seams first, then the side seams around them.
All-in-one facing; CB zip; hem 3 cm.

jours.obj: Draft the senator top from the shirt pattern and cut top and trousers in one layout.
items: Shirt pattern without yoke; lengthen to the senator length.
Hip ÷ 4 + 3 from the waist down; side slits 20 cm.
Mandarin collar neck ÷ 2 + 1 on the fold, 3.5 high; half placket 25 × 3.
Long sleeve with plain cuff or turned hem.
Trousers from Week 3 (straight or tapered); one layout for both.
jours.apporter: Shirt + trousers patterns, hip, senator length
jours.devoir: Design an embroidery or piping detail for the placket.

jours.obj: Sew the complete senator ensemble in one session.
items: Top: half placket, shoulders, mandarin collar, sleeves.
Side seams to the slits; face the slits.
Trousers: side pockets, seams, elastic or buttoned waistband.
Hems, buttons, press.
Present the ensemble on a person.

jours.obj: Draft a fitted top with peplum, a wrapper skirt and a head-tie.
items: Choose the model with the teacher: neckline, sleeve, peplum depth, wrapper length.
Top: bodice block cut at the waist. Quarter-circle peplum: radius = waist × 4 ÷ 6.28.
Wrapper: 2 panels, overlap 25 cm; total waist = waist + 25 + 2.
Head-tie: 180 × 50 cm, straight grain.
Plan the layout for 6 yards; cut all pieces.
jours.apporter: Bust, waist, hip, shoulder, lengths, head round
jours.devoir: Calculate the fabric for one size bigger.

jours.obj: Sew the complete 3-piece ensemble.
items: Overlock; darts; shoulders; neck facing; understitch.
Sleeves; side seams; invisible zip at CB.
Peplum: rolled hem first, then attach at the waist.
Wrapper: waistband, ties 80 × 4, 3 cm hem by hand. Head-tie: rolled hem, mitred corners.
Press all three pieces; present on the dress form.

jours.obj: Draft and sew real wide palazzo trousers in one day.
items: Same crotch, hip and waist lines as the trousers; darts instead of pleats.
No knee narrowing. Hem front = bottom ÷ 2 - 1 + 15; back = bottom ÷ 2 + 1 + 15.
Draw side seam and inseam straight from hip and crotch to the hem.
Invisible zip at the side; facing or narrow waistband.
Hem 4 cm (1 + 1 on light fabric); fit; press.
jours.apporter: Waist, hip, bottom, length, crotch depth

jours.obj: Join the bodice block and the trousers into a jumpsuit that lets the wearer sit and bend.
items: Take A, B and C on your client.
Trace the bodice; the waist of bodice and trousers must match: waist ÷ 4 + 1 + dart.
Add movement ease: 1.5 under the bodice waist + 1.5 above the trouser waist.
Back crotch extension hip ÷ 10 + 1.
Check A and B on the paper; correct before cutting. CB zip 55 cm.
jours.apporter: Block, trousers, total crotch length A, trunk B, waist to floor C

jours.obj: Sew the jumpsuit to selling quality.
items: Bodice: darts, shoulders, sides. Trousers: darts, side seams, inseams.
Crotch seam from the front waist to the zip mark; press over the ham.
Join bodice and trousers at the waist: CF, darts and side seams matched.
Invisible CB zip; all-in-one facing or neck facing + sleeves.
Try on: she sits and bends without pulling. Hems; press.

jours.t: Mid-term test: shirt in one session
jours.obj: Show that you can make a complete shirt alone, in one session.
items: Calculate with the shirt rules; the teacher checks.
Draft or adapt your pattern.
Cut and sew the full shirt.
Buttons and pressing.
Hand in with your calculation sheet.
jours.devoir: Read the teacher's comments and correct your notes.

jours.obj: Draft a single-breasted jacket with notched lapel and its collar.
items: Width = chest ÷ 4 + 4 (over a shirt).
Shoulder = shoulder ÷ 2 + 1 (pad); slope 4 cm only.
Armhole depth chest ÷ 4 + 2; front neck width neck ÷ 6 + 0.5.
Button extension 2.5; first button on the waist line; roll line neck point to first button.
Lapel 8.5 cm outside the roll line; notch; under and upper collar.
Front dart 1.5 cm, 10 cm from CF; pocket positions.
jours.apporter: Neck, shoulder, chest, waist, hip, jacket length, back length
jours.devoir: Draw the lapel in 3 widths: 7, 8.5, 10 cm.

jours.obj: Complete every pattern piece, cut shell, lining and interfacing, and fuse.
items: Two-piece sleeve: cap = armhole ÷ 3 + 1; curve = armhole + 3 to 4; split top and under sleeve.
Front facing with lapel; back neck facing; under collar on the bias (2 pieces).
Lining: 1 cm pleat at CB, 1 cm extra length.
Cut shell, lining, interfacing; fuse front, facings, collars, hems.
Mark darts, pockets, buttonholes; tape the roll line (pulled 0.5 cm).
jours.apporter: Armhole measured, sleeve, arm round, wrist
jours.devoir: Walk the seams: check all pieces fit together.

jours.obj: Make the darts and pockets, assemble the shell and set collar and lapels.
items: Front darts; flap pockets each side; breast welt on the left front.
CB, sides, shoulders (ease the back 0.5 cm).
Under collar to the neckline; upper collar to the facing.
Facing to front along lapel and collar; clip at the notch; trim, grade, turn.
Understitch below the break point; press the lapel roll on the ham.

jours.obj: Set the sleeves, bag the lining and finish the jacket to selling quality.
items: Sleeve seams, vent with 3–4 buttons; ease the cap and shrink the ease with the iron.
Set sleeves; sleeve head roll and shoulder pads.
Lining to facings; hems; bag through 20 cm left open in a sleeve lining seam.
Keyhole buttonholes; buttons with thread shank.
Final press with a cloth; try on; teacher evaluation.

jours.obj: Draft and sew a lined men's waistcoat in one session.
items: Width = chest ÷ 4 + 1.5; shoulder narrowed 3 cm; armhole 2 cm lower than the shirt.
V-neck to the first button; 5 buttons 8 cm apart; front point 5 cm below the side.
Back in lining fabric with adjuster belt.
Two welt pockets; bag shell and lining; turn through the side seams.
Buttonholes, buttons, press.
jours.apporter: Neck, shoulder, chest, waist, waistcoat length

jours.obj: Draft a sleeveless shirt dress: fitted bodice, mandarin collar, button stand, waistband, box-pleated skirt and side pockets.
items: Bodice: trace the block to the waist; sleeveless: shoulder ÷ 2 - 2, armhole raised 1 cm.
Front: button stand 2 cm + facing 3.5 cm beyond CF; widen the neck 0.5 cm for the collar.
Mandarin collar: neck ÷ 2 + 1 long, 3.5 cm high, CB on the fold, front ends curved.
Waistband 4 cm finished, as long as the bodice waist with the darts closed (+ stand on the front).
Skirt panel: waist ÷ 4 + 1 + 2 box pleats of 8 cm; hem = waist panel + 8; length = dress - back length - 4.
Pocket: opening 16 cm, 4 cm under the waistband; bag 20 × 25. Cut; fuse collar, stand and waistband.
jours.apporter: Bust, waist, shoulder, neck, back length, dress length
jours.devoir: Cut all pieces and press the pleats on a card.

jours.obj: Sew the shirt dress to selling quality: clean collar, even pleats, invisible pockets.
items: Darts; shoulders; bodice side seams.
Collar: interface, sew, trim, turn, edge-stitch; attach between the CF lines.
Armholes: bias facing 2.5 cm, understitch, topstitch 1 cm.
Skirt: baste the box pleats; pocket bags to the side seams; side seams around the pockets.
Waistband between bodice and skirt; topstitch 2 mm.
Front facings; hem 3 cm; 12 buttonholes; buttons; press.

jours.t: Blouse with Peter Pan collar & puff sleeves
jours.obj: Draft a flat collar on the neckline and a gathered puff sleeve.
items: Overlap the front and back shoulders 2 cm; draw the collar 6 cm wide on the neckline.
Puff sleeve: slash the cap 4 times, open 3 cm each, raise the top 3 cm.
Sleeve band = arm round + 3.
Gather the cap between the notches; set.
CB buttons or zip; hem 2 cm.

jours.t: Kaba (fitted long dress with flounce): draft & cut
jours.obj: Draft a fitted princess kaba to the knee with a circular flounce and 3/4 puff sleeves.
items: Princess pattern fitted to the knee: knee ÷ 4 + 1 per quarter.
Flounce: half circle, depth = dress length - waist to knee, inner edge = knee round + 4.
3/4 puff sleeve: slash cap, + 3 cm height; sleeve length 45.
CB zip 55 cm; lining to the knee.
Cut shell and lining.
jours.apporter: Princess pattern, waist to knee, dress length

jours.obj: Sew the kaba with a smooth flounce and a level hem.
items: Princess seams; zip; lining.
Sleeves with gathered cap.
Attach the flounce at the knee line; press seam up.
Let it hang; level on the dress form; rolled hem.
Final fitting; press.

jours.obj: Draft a fitted off-shoulder dress with princess seams, portrait band, cap sleeves and a 3/4 circle skirt.
items: Measure G: round the body over the upper arms, 8 cm under the shoulder point, tape firm.
Bodice from the block: top line 8 cm under the shoulder point; top width = G ÷ 4 - 1 so the dress holds itself up.
Princess seams through the bust point; the dart value goes into the seam; CB zip on the back.
Portrait band: half = G ÷ 2 + 1, 8 cm deep, curved like the top line; cut 2 + interfacing.
Cap sleeve: arm round + 4 long, 6 cm deep in the middle.
Skirt 3/4 circle: radius = waist ÷ 4.71; 4 quarters; length = dress - back length.
jours.apporter: Bust, waist, off-shoulder round G, arm round, back length, dress length
jours.devoir: Cut all pieces; hang the skirt quarters overnight.

jours.obj: Sew the off-shoulder dress so the neckline stays up without straps.
items: Princess seams; 6 mm rigilène boning on the princess and side seams of the lining, 2 cm under the top.
Band: interface; piping on the lower edge; attach to the top with the cap sleeves between.
Elastic 1 cm = G - 6 in the top seam allowance (or silicone gripper tape).
Join the skirt quarters; level the hem on the dress form; attach to the bodice with a grosgrain waist stay.
Invisible CB zip 50 cm; lining; narrow rolled hem with contrast piping.
Try on: she lifts her arms – the band must not slide down.

jours.obj: Receive a real client from the atelier like a professional.
items: Greet the client; listen; sketch the model; choose the fabric together.
Take all measurements; write them on the order sheet.
Calculate; the teacher checks.
Fabric quantity and price (fabric + trimmings + work).
Draft and cut.
jours.apporter: All measurements for the chosen garment
jours.devoir: Fill in the order sheet completely.

jours.obj: Sew the client's garment to the fitting stage.
items: Main seams with long stitches where the fitting may change them.
First fitting; mark corrections with pins and chalk.
Correct the pattern too, not only the garment.
Sew the corrected seams.
Prepare for finishing.
jours.devoir: Note every correction on the order sheet.

jours.obj: Deliver a finished, pressed, packed garment to the client.
items: Hems, buttons, clean all threads inside.
Final press; hang or fold with tissue.
Final fitting; client signature.
Record time, cost, price, profit.
Portfolio photo.
jours.devoir: What did the client like? What will you improve?

jours.t: Women's tailored trousers with jetted pockets
jours.obj: Make high-waisted women's trousers with front pleats and jetted pockets.
items: Trousers draft for a woman; waist raised 4 cm (high waist).
Two front pleats 2.5 cm each; back darts 2 × 2.
Jetted pocket 13 cm at the front hip, 5 cm under the waist.
Side invisible zip or front fly.
Waistband 4 cm; hem 4 cm; press the crease.

jours.obj: Revise all the rules of the trimester and pass the written quiz.
items: Revise shirt, trousers, pockets, bodice, skirts, jacket.
Written quiz: 20 questions (calculations, vocabulary, order of operations).
Correction together.
Check your portfolio: one photo per garment.
Prepare your tools for the practical exam.

jours.obj: Draft and cut a garment drawn by lot, alone, on your own client's measurements.
items: Draw by lot: shirt, trousers, dress, senator or skirt ensemble.
Write the measurements on the exam sheet; calculate; show your sheet.
Draft with all notches and grain lines.
Cut; the teacher marks layout and cutting.
Store your pieces for tomorrow.

jours.obj: Sew and finish the exam garment.
items: Sew in the correct order of operations.
Finish inside and outside.
Press.
Hand in on a hanger with your calculation sheet.
The teacher marks: fit, finish, stitching, pressing, time.

jours.obj: Present your work and receive your trimester evaluation.
items: Present your 3 best garments to the class.
Hand in your portfolio.
Receive your trimester report.
Set 3 personal goals for Trimester 2.
Clean and oil your machine.
